title: QSBS §1202 Exclusion Calculator
description: Estimate the §1202 qualified small business stock gain exclusion under OBBBA rules: tiered exclusion (50/75/100%) based on holding period, $15M / 10× basis cap, and $75M gross asset threshold for post-OBBBA issuances.
data_vintage: 2026 OBBBA §1202 rules (signed July 4, 2025): 3yr=50%, 4yr=75%, 5yr=100%; cap $15M or 10× basis; gross asset threshold $75M for stock issued after 7/4/2025
regulatory_citations: IRC §1202 as amended by OBBBA (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, signed July 4, 2025)
Pre-OBBBA (stock issued before 7/4/2025): 5yr hold = 100% exclusion; gross asset threshold $50M
Post-OBBBA (stock issued after 7/4/2025): 3yr=50%, 4yr=75%, 5yr=100%; gross asset threshold $75M; cap = greater of $15M or 10× adjusted basis
28% rate on non-excluded QSBS gain (under pre-TCJA rules still applicable to §1202)
Annual exclusion limit per taxpayer per issuer: $10M or 10× adjusted basis

mcp_tool_definition.name: calculate_qsbs_exclusion
mcp_tool_definition.description: Estimate IRC §1202 QSBS gain exclusion under OBBBA tiered rates, model excluded vs. taxable gain, and compare pre- and post-OBBBA issuance scenarios.
